About Us
NDT TechOps Pty Ltd is an Australian engineering services company specialising in Non-Destructive Testing (NDT), inspection, asset integrity, quality assurance and technical reporting. We provide inspection and engineering support across the mining, construction, manufacturing, oil & gas and infrastructure sectors.

As our business continues to grow, we are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Contract Administrator to support the administration of engineering projects, contractual documentation and client service delivery.

About the Role
The Contract Administrator plays a key role in supporting the successful delivery of inspection and engineering projects by managing contract documentation, coordinating project administration activities and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and company procedures.

The position works closely with project managers, engineers, NDT inspectors and clients to facilitate efficient project delivery and maintain accurate project records.

Key Responsibilities
-Administer engineering service contracts from commencement through to completion. 
-Prepare, review, and maintain contractual documentation, quotations, purchase orders, and project records. 
-Overseeing work by contractors and reporting on variations to work orders.
-Monitor contract performance against agreed terms and conditions.
-Support tender submissions and contract variations. 
-Liaise with clients, suppliers, inspectors, and project managers regarding contract administration matters. 
-Maintain confidential commercial and contractual information. 
-Manage document control processes and maintain accurate electronic records. 
-Monitor project costs and assist with budget tracking. 
-Coordinate project documentation and ensure compliance with contractual requirements. 
-Ensure company procedures and quality management systems are followed. 
-Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and reporting efficiency. 

Essential Skills & Experience
-Diploma, Advanced Diploma or higher qualification in business, administration, information technology or a related field; or
-At least one year of equivalent industry in a similar role e.g. in contract administration, supplier coordination, commercial administration and business administration or engineering administration. 
-Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
-Strong organisational and time management abilities. 
-High level of attention to detail. 
-Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. 
-Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Word. 
-Experience maintaining electronic document management systems. 
-Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Desirable
-Experience with commercial contract management, especially within engineering, construction, mining or industrial services. 
-Exposure to Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) or technical reporting environments. 
-Understanding of quality management systems. 
-Experience supporting project delivery within technical industries.

What We Offer
Competitive salary: $79,423 per year + superannuation
Full-time permanent employment. 
Supportive and collaborative working environment. 
Exposure to major engineering and infrastructure projects. 
Professional growth within Australia's engineering services industry.

I am responsible for delivering outstanding QSC, sales, people practices and profit on my shifts.  I supervise employees to ensure that restaurant operations and procedures are adhered to. I engage with crew and fellow managers to deliver great business outcomes by bringing the Macca’s Experience to life on each and every shift. I ensure every customer has a memorable McDonald’s experience.
I comply with restaurant safety and security standards which includes investigating all incidents and taking corrective actions to ensure a safe working environment for all employees and customers. I escalate safety and security matters to the Restaurant Manager where necessary. In addition to supervising employees, I am responsible for ensuring the restaurant is stocked with sufficient product and that the kitchen is operating effectively to serve gold standard food, to every customer
QSC&V
Core Responsibilities
• I adapt to our customer’s ever-changing needs and strive to deliver outstanding QSC&V with an added ouch of the Macca’s Experience by utilising shift planning tools.
• I take responsibility and ownership for ensuring excellent food safety throughout the shift, by complying with McDonald’s and government food safety standards.
• I am responsible for planned and daily maintenance of equipment to ensure cleanliness and correct working order.
Secondary Responsibilities
• I follow up on the maintenance of the restaurant building, plant and equipment — troubleshooting and calibrating when necessary to maintain QSC&V.
• I ensure production metrics (e.g. side 2 percentage, KVS time, and 15 minute burger count) are achieved to drive kitchen performance and overall speed of service.
PEOPLE
Core Responsibilities
• I role model, enforce and educate crew on relevant McDonald’s Policies, such as Respectful Workplace and Social Media, employment laws, security and safety procedures.
• I communicate effectively to convey information and ideas in an open and timely manner. I provide feedback to previous and subsequent Shift Managers to identify opportunities, results and restaurant trends. 
• I actively seek out opportunities to coach and develop crew. With the support of my Restaurant Manager I identify and take action to resolve
performance opportunities and conduct yearly crew performance reviews on assigned department crew. 
Secondary Responsibilities
• I verify employees are adequately trained on the completion of relevant PM tasks.
PROFIT
Core Responsibilities
• Personally accept accountability for the results of myself and others on my shifts, in the pursuit of sustained profitable growth.
• I demonstrate an overarching understanding of the impact my shifts may have on overall profitability of the restaurant and show consideration for inventory, labour and cash control.
• I am accountable for cash control on my shifts, ensuring that cash is managed in accordance with McDonald’s Policies and Procedures.
Secondary Responsibilities
• I maintain the accuracy of the ordering system and the completion of stock orders whilst ensuring delivery accuracy and product rotation.
• I analyse food cost components (raw and completed waste, food promotions, T-reds, employee and manager meals, and condiments) to develop and communicate weekly food cost action plans to managers and crew.

SALES
Core Responsibilities
• I actively seek customer feedback during my shift to ensure an exceptional customer experience is achieved, driving repeat business.
• I execute the restaurant marketing plan to maximise sales and ensure that the plan is communicated to all crew on shift.
• I am responsible for reviewing and monitoring guest counts and sales projections to ensure they are aligned to shift targets and restaurant goals.
Secondary Responsibilities
• I generate, analyse and present restaurant results in relation to food control to uncover ways to drive improved performance.
• I ensure the completion of weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual PM tasks to ensure equipment is in good working condition to meet customer demand.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Group Project Manager (Fixed term 24 months)

Lead Major Health Infrastructure Projects That Shape Patient Care

At Epworth, we believe every patient matters. As Victoria's largest not-for-profit private healthcare group, we are committed to delivering outstanding care and creating environments that support exceptional patient experiences.

We are seeking an experienced Group Project Manager to join our Redevelopment team and lead the planning, delivery and commissioning of complex health infrastructure projects across multiple Epworth locations. Reporting to the Group Manager Redevelopment, you will manage projects ranging from $100,000 to $30 million, ensuring delivery on scope, schedule, quality and budget objectives.

The Opportunity

This is a pivotal role responsible for managing redevelopment, refurbishment and capital works projects from concept through to completion. Working closely with executives, clinical leaders, consultants, contractors and key stakeholders, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently and with minimal disruption to hospital operations.

You will coordinate planning, design, construction, commissioning and operational transition activities while maintaining strong governance, stakeholder engagement and financial oversight.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the delivery of redevelopment and construction projects across multiple Epworth sites.

Manage project scope, budgets, schedules, risks and quality outcomes.

Coordinate stakeholder workshops, planning meetings and project governance activities.

Oversee consultants, contractors and suppliers throughout all project phases.

Drive health planning, design coordination and commissioning activities.

Monitor and report project financial performance and budget status.

Ensure statutory, compliance and operational requirements are met.

Facilitate effective communication between clinical, operational and project teams.

Support smooth handover, transition and defect management processes.

 Position Description Inherent Requirement

About You

You are a highly organised and commercially astute project professional with a strong track record delivering large-scale construction or redevelopment projects within complex environments.

To be successful, you will bring:

Relevant qualifications in Construction Management, Property, Project Management or a related discipline.

Minimum five years' experience delivering major construction projects.

Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Strong financial management, reporting and budget tracking capability.

Exceptional stakeholder engagement, communication and influencing skills.

Demonstrated ability to lead through complexity and competing priorities.

Strong project governance, risk management and problem-solving skills.

Advanced proficiency in project management and reporting systems.

Highly Regarded

Experience delivering hospital, healthcare or major infrastructure projects.

Engineering qualifications or technical construction expertise.

Why Epworth?

At Epworth, our people make a difference every day. We offer the opportunity to contribute to projects that directly enhance patient care while working alongside experienced healthcare, operational and redevelopment professionals.

At Epworth, it's a community.

It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation and a team that works to make sure that every patient matters. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

Relocation assistance is available for approved candidates

This includes First Nations peoples, people with disability, mature-age and young job seekers, members of the LGBTIQA+ community, and individuals from all cultural backgrounds. Desirable Skills

•	Knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.

•	Understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise networking and managed IT services.

•	Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, Trello, Monday.com or similar project management platforms.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

Why Join Loginet Technologies?

At Loginet Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects involving Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, intelligent automation, cloud computing, cybersecurity and digital transformation. We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their technical expertise, contribute to meaningful client outcomes and build long-term careers within a growing Australian technology company.

result.description:
Perfection Fresh Australia Pty Ltd is a leading Australian fresh produce company specialising in the growing, sourcing, marketing, and distribution of premium-quality fruit and vegetables. The company is committed to sustainable horticultural practices, ethical sourcing, and innovation, working closely with growers and industry partners to deliver high-quality produce while promoting a culture of excellence, collaboration, and safety. We are seeking a full time Research, Development & Analysis Manager to join our berry division. In this role, you will lead the design, coordination, and analysis of berry research, trial, and performance programs across Perfection Fresh Australia-owned farms and selected third-party growers. This role will be based in Caboolture, QLD.

Base salary: $79,423 per annum (plus super)

Main Responsibilities:
•	Determine, implement and monitor berry research and development strategies, trial programs and project plans aligned with commercial and production objectives.
•	Develop and coordinate research projects and variety trials across company farms and grower sites, including trial design, methodologies, timelines and data collection.
•	Lead and coordinate research activities by working with farm managers, growers, breeders, nursery partners and technical stakeholders to achieve project objectives.
•	Assess the effectiveness and commercial outcomes of research and development activities by evaluating varietal performance, yield, quality, harvest efficiency, labour productivity and grower returns.
•	Collect, analyse and interpret research and production data to identify trends, evaluate trial outcomes and support evidence-based decision-making.
•	Evaluate new berry varieties and production practices and recommend commercialisation strategies and operational improvements based on research findings.
•	Provide technical advice and research-based recommendations to management, production teams and growers on varietal selection, production practices and continuous improvement initiatives.
•	Monitor emerging developments in berry production, breeding programs and research methodologies, and assess their potential application to the organisation's research priorities.
•	Prepare and maintain research reports, trial records, databases and technical documentation, and communicate research findings to internal and external stakeholders.

Required Qualification and Experience:
•	A bachelor's in a related field to horticultural/agricultural science.
•	At least 2 years of work experience in horticulture, agriculture, berry production, agronomy, research and development, trial coordination, data analysis or a closely related technical role.

Ideal Skills and Attributes:
•	Strong data collection, analysis and interpretation skills, with the ability to convert data into practical operational recommendations.
